# Get Last Video

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves the last n videos you recorded.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getLastVideo(count: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getLastVideo(count: 1)
~~~~
